orgDesign.companyProfile: Vortex-informed specialist investment manager. Public sources identify investment, operating, technology, and finance/ESG roles; the responsibility teams below are proposed and do not reproduce an actual org chart.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Five logical responsibility teams with shared roles and external specialists. Headcounts and group leadership allocations are deliberately unspecified because they are unknown. These are not five independently staffed engineering squads. Each brick has one accountable owner; management, fund, committee, valuation, and payment authorities remain distinct. Team charter metrics refer to customer KPI names. See _domain/DOMAIN.md for evidence and assumptions.

groups.name: Investment and Company Partnerships
groups.mission: Coordinate the shared responsibilities for investment and company partnerships. Leadership staffing is not inferred.
